title: VTA Calendar — Sync — payload
description: A client asks its VTA to read now, from each community the principal belongs to, the events the principal registered for — in one trust context or in every one the caller has standing in — where the principal has chosen to sync. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

contextId.description: Only this context. Absent: every context the caller has standing in.

Response.title: VTA Calendar — Sync — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/calendar/sync/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/calendar/sync/0.1#response.

results.description: One per community the VTA read, or would have read, for the contexts asked about.
